name: git-commands
description: COMMIT.md rules based Git commit, push, and PR automation

interface.shortDescription: Automate commits, pushes, and PRs using COMMIT.md rules.
interface.longDescription: Provides Codex skills for creating commits, pushing branches, and opening pull requests while applying the repository's COMMIT.md conventions.
defaultPrompt: Use git-commands-commit to create a commit.
Use git-commands-commit-push to commit and push.
Use git-commands-commit-push-pr to create a PR.
